source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.1 with Table 9.6, the Ca(OH)2 sample and the ionic product table, printed pages 202-204.

blocks.text: Compound ke formula aur us ki Ksp qeemat se namaloom molar solubility S nikali jati hai aur ions ki concentrations tay hoti hain. Table 9.6 kuch kam halne wale compounds ki Ksp qeematon aur solubility ka taalluq deti hai.

blocks.caption: Solubility aur solubility product (Table 9.6, print ke mutabiq)
rows: 1.69 x 10^-4 (print; text aur Table 9.5 mein 1.6 x 10^-8)

blocks.text: Ca(OH)2 kam halne wala hai, Ksp = 6.5 x 10^-6; us ki solubility nikalein. Solubility S mol dm-3 maan lein. Balanced muadla Ca(OH)2 se Ca2+ + 2OH- 0 aur 0 se shuru ho kar equilibrium par S aur 2S tak pohnchta hai; OH- ki concentration Ca2+ se dugni hai, to Ksp = [Ca2+][OH-]^2 = S x (2S)^2 = 4S^3 = 6.5 x 10^-6. Phir S^3 = 6.5 x 10^-6 / 4 = 1.625 x 10^-6, S = (1.625)^(1/3) x 10^-2 = 1.18 x 10^-2 mol dm-3. Equilibrium par 1.18 x 10^-2 mol dm-3 Ca2+ aur 2 x 1.18 x 10^-2 = 2.36 x 10^-2 mol dm-3 OH- maujood hain; alag alag ion concentrations solubility product se nikal aai hain.

Common ion ki maujoodgi kam halne wale ionic compound ki solubility ghatati hai. Kam halne wale salt PbCrO4 ke saturated solution mein PbCrO4 se Pb2+(aq) + CrO4 2-(aq); halne wala salt Na2CrO4 shamil karna common ion CrO4 2- deta hai, jo Pb2+ se mil kar mazeed na-halne wala PbCrO4 banata hai, to Ksp mustaqil rakhne ke liye equilibrium baen shift hota hai.

Solubility product yeh bhi batata hai ke salt precipitate hoga ya nahi. CaSO4 ka solubility product 2 x 10^-5 hai. Agar 25 degrees C par 10^-2 mol dm-3 Ca2+ solution 10^-2 mol dm-3 SO4 2- solution mein dala jaye to har ion dilute ho kar [Ca2+] = [SO4 2-] = 10^-2 / 2 = 5.0 x 10^-3 mol dm-3 hota hai, aur ionic product [Ca2+][SO4 2-] = 5.0 x 10^-3 x 5.0 x 10^-3 = 2.5 x 10^-5 mol2 dm-6, jo Ksp se zyada hai, to CaSO4 precipitate hota hai.

blocks.prompt: AgCl ka Ksp 1.77 x 10^-10 hai. 0.10 M NaCl mein AgCl ki solubility nikalein, aur batayein ke 10^-3 mol dm-3 Ca2+ aur SO4 2- milane par CaSO4 precipitate hoga ya nahi (Quick Check 9.5a, b).
blocks.explanation: 0.10 M NaCl mein salt ka chloride ghalib hai: Ksp = [Ag+][Cl-] = S x 0.10, to S = 1.77 x 10^-10 / 0.10 = 1.8 x 10^-9 mol dm-3, khalis pani ke 1.3 x 10^-5 mol dm-3 se kahin kam (common ion effect). CaSO4 ke liye barabar hajm milane se har concentration aadhi ho kar 5 x 10^-4 hoti hai, to ionic product 2.5 x 10^-7, Ksp = 2 x 10^-5 se kam: solution unsaturated hai aur precipitate nahi banta.

items: Ksp se solubility: Ca(OH)2 ke liye Ksp = S(2S)^2 = 4S^3 = 6.5 x 10^-6 se S = 1.18 x 10^-2 mol dm-3 aur [OH-] = 2.36 x 10^-2 mol dm-3.
Common ion solubility ghatata hai (saturated PbCrO4 mein Na2CrO4 equilibrium baen shift karta hai); precipitation sirf tab jab ionic product Ksp se barh jaye (CaSO4: 2.5 x 10^-5, 2 x 10^-5 se zyada).
